---
title: "Flight Delay Guesser"
subtitle: "Interactive operational simulator: test your intuition against real-world airline departure data."
---

```{=html}
<div class="panel-card my-4" style="max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto;">
  <div class="panel-header">
    <h4 class="panel-title">Operations Simulator: Delay Predictor</h4>
    <span class="badge" style="background-color: #14283F;">FAA 15-MIN RULE</span>
  </div>
  
  <p class="text-secondary small mb-3">An FAA delayed flight departed more than 15 minutes past schedule. Evaluate the flight attributes below and predict whether this departure was delayed or on-time:</p>
  
  <div id="game-card" class="p-4 mb-3 border rounded text-center" style="background-color: #F8FAFC; border-color: #D4E3ED !important;">
    <h4 id="flight-info" class="fw-bold font-mono mb-2" style="color: #14283F;">Loading flight...</h4>
    <div id="flight-details" class="text-secondary small font-mono"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3 mb-3">
    <button id="btn-ontime" class="btn btn-outline-success px-4 fw-semibold" onclick="makeGuess(false)">● On Time (&le;15m)</button>
    <button id="btn-delayed" class="btn btn-outline-danger px-4 fw-semibold" onclick="makeGuess(true)">▲ Delayed (&gt;15m)</button>
  </div>

  <div id="game-feedback" class="alert d-none text-center" role="alert"></div>

  <div class="d-flex justify-content-around text-center border-top pt-3 mt-3">
    <div>
      <div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">Accuracy Score</div>
      <div class="font-mono fw-bold fs-5"><span id="game-score">0</span> / <span id="game-total">0</span></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="text-muted small text-uppercase">Current Streak</div>
      <div class="font-mono fw-bold fs-5" style="color: #D69A43;"><span id="game-streak">0</span> 🔥</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  
  <div class="text-center mt-3">
    <button id="btn-next" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm d-none" style="background-color: #14283F; border-color: #14283F;" onclick="nextRound()">Next Flight &rarr;</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const flights = [
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "Delta Air Lines", dest: "Los Angeles (LAX)", time: "06:15 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: -3, fact: "Early morning flights are much less likely to be delayed because planes are already parked at gates overnight." },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "United Airlines", dest: "San Francisco (SFO)", time: "07:30 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 68, fact: "Evening transcontinental flights often absorb delays accumulated across multiple upstream airspace legs." },
  { origin: "LGA", carrier: "American Airlines", dest: "Chicago (ORD)", time: "08:45 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: 4, fact: "Morning departures at LGA frequently depart within scheduled slots." },
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "JetBlue", dest: "Orlando (MCO)", time: "05:40 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 42, fact: "Late afternoon flights face congestion as leisure and business banks intersect." },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "ExpressJet", dest: "Atlanta (ATL)", time: "09:00 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 115, fact: "Late night regional flights are especially vulnerable to cascading crew duty-hour limits." },
  { origin: "LGA", carrier: "Delta Air Lines", dest: "Miami (MIA)", time: "11:00 AM", delayed: false, delayMin: 0, fact: "Mid-morning turnarounds at LGA maintain high schedule adherence." },
  { origin: "JFK", carrier: "Virgin America", dest: "San Francisco (SFO)", time: "03:10 PM", delayed: false, delayMin: 12, fact: "Delayed by 12 minutes—which still qualifies as on-time under the official 15-minute FAA standard!" },
  { origin: "EWR", carrier: "United Airlines", dest: "Denver (DEN)", time: "04:20 PM", delayed: true, delayMin: 55, fact: "Late afternoon departure banks at Newark frequently incur taxi-out ground queue holds." }
];

let currentIdx = 0;
let score = 0;
let total = 0;
let streak = 0;
let answered = false;

function loadFlight() {
  answered = false;
  const f = flights[currentIdx];
  document.getElementById('flight-info').innerText = `${f.origin} ✈ ${f.dest}`;
  document.getElementById('flight-details').innerText = `Carrier: ${f.carrier} | Scheduled: ${f.time}`;
  const feedback = document.getElementById('game-feedback');
  feedback.className = 'alert d-none text-center';
  document.getElementById('btn-next').classList.add('d-none');
  document.getElementById('btn-ontime').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('btn-delayed').disabled = false;
}

function makeGuess(guessedDelayed) {
  if (answered) return;
  answered = true;
  total++;
  const f = flights[currentIdx];
  const feedback = document.getElementById('game-feedback');
  const correct = (guessedDelayed === f.delayed);

  document.getElementById('btn-ontime').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('btn-delayed').disabled = true;

  if (correct) {
    score++;
    streak++;
    feedback.className = 'alert alert-success text-center py-2';
    feedback.innerHTML = `<strong>Correct! 🎉</strong> Actual departure delay: ${f.delayMin > 0 ? '+' : ''}${f.delayMin} min.<br><span class="small">${f.fact}</span>`;
  } else {
    streak = 0;
    feedback.className = 'alert alert-danger text-center py-2';
    feedback.innerHTML = `<strong>Not quite! ✈️</strong> Actual departure delay: ${f.delayMin > 0 ? '+' : ''}${f.delayMin} min.<br><span class="small">${f.fact}</span>`;
  }
  feedback.classList.remove('d-none');
  document.getElementById('game-score').innerText = score;
  document.getElementById('game-total').innerText = total;
  document.getElementById('game-streak').innerText = streak;
  document.getElementById('btn-next').classList.remove('d-none');
}

function nextRound() {
  currentIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % flights.length;
  loadFlight();
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadFlight);
if (document.readyState === "complete" || document.readyState === "interactive") {
  loadFlight();
}
</script>
```

    <div class="mb-2 mb-md-0">
      <strong style="color: #14283F;">AeroIntel</strong> &bull; Aviation Operations &amp; Delay Intelligence Platform
    </div>
    <div class="text-secondary">
      Data: U.S. DOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics &amp; FAA &bull; System Status: <span style="color: #25845D; font-weight: 600;">Operational</span>
    </div>

</footer>
